verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a hosted ID-verification SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Stripe Identity's own source code being released under an open license. The public stripe/openapi repository is a machine-readable API specification, not the product's source, so it is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
